items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: All the neighbors, if their car broke down, here comes – here they come. They’re going to get Leon to fix their car.

ctx.x: You were saying your sister acted up in school, and mom had to go to school to hear about it from the teachers.

She had to go. That was the day they asked her to come to school, so they could talk to her and tell her about what my sister was doing. On the way to school with my sister, they got to a point where they were crossing the street. This driver shot out from – wanted to get to the front of the cars, and there was space for it. But my sister stepped out in the street. My mother saw it, and she reached for my sister to save her. Pushed her back off the curb of the street. The car hit my mother instead of hitting my…
So the death of your mother – where . . .? – tell us about how you learned about it.
